statements: People lose items in their basket to someone quicker. Add reserve(store, { sku, qty, user }, now) and release(store, reservationId, now) to src/reservations.mjs. A reservation holds stock for the time in src/config.mjs and returns { id, sku, qty, expiresAt }.
Reserved stock is not available to anyone else, for as long as the reservation lives. Everything in the service that deals with stock must respect that.

checkout gains an optional reservationId in its options, which spends that reservation. Asking for more than is available throws the usual out_of_stock error, for a reservation too. Releasing twice is harmless.
Time is the now passed in. The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add stock reservations to the shop, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
